outcome: Delivery route (cesarean, outlet forceps, ventouse, normal delivery)
cohort: The study assessed 200 women with single live-term intrauterine unscarred pregnancies undergoing labor induction.
finding: Mifepristone was found to be efficacious and safe for inducing labor and cervical ripening in subjects with full-term pregnancies.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was cesarean in 8.5%, outlet forceps delivery in 1.55%, ventouse delivery in 3%, and normal delivery in 87% of study subjects.
gest_age: Term pregnancies (single live-term intrauterine unscarred pregnancies, full-term pregnancy)
